---
title: "Early Prediction of PFS from Confirmed Response and Tumor Sizes"
author: "Karim Naguib"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(magrittr)
library(tidyverse)
library(rlang)
library(cmdstanr)
library(loo)
library(posterior)
library(tidybayes)
library(bayesplot)
library(here)
library(targets)
library(colorspace)

# Using different temp directories on SCP and locally.
tmp_dir <- if (nchar(Sys.getenv("TMP")) > 0) file.path(Sys.getenv("TMPDIR"), "adc-early-predict") else here("temp")

knitr::opts_chunk$set(cache.path = file.path("/wscratch", Sys.getenv("USER"), "adc-early-predict/cache/"))

ggplot2::theme_set(theme_minimal(base_family = "Arial"))

source(here("r", "util.R"))
source(here("r", "crcr.R"))

tar_config_set(store = file.path(tmp_dir, "_targets"), script = here("_targets.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: load-analysis-data
#| cache: true
#| cache-lazy: true

tar_load(c("treated_confirmed_resp_analysis_data", "treated_confirmed_resp_stan_data"))
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10

treated_confirmed_resp_analysis_data |> 
  ggplot(aes(confirmed_response_week)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = confirmed_response_censored), alpha = 0.75, position = "stack") +
  scale_x_continuous("Confirmed Response Week", breaks = (seq(0, 126, by = 12))) +
  scale_fill_discrete("Censored") +
  facet_wrap(vars(trial), scales = "free_y") 
```

```{r}
tar_read("km_confirmed_response") |> 
  set_names(c("s", "n", "c", "e")) |>
  as_tibble() |> 
  mutate(t = seq(0, n() - 1)) |> 
  ggplot() +
  geom_step(aes(t, s), direction = "vh") +
  scale_x_continuous("Confirmed Response Week", breaks = (seq(0, 126, by = 12))) +
  labs(y = "Proportion Unclassified") +
  NULL
```

```{r}
treated_confirmed_resp_analysis_data |> 
  select(trial, n_tumors, t_measure) |> 
  unnest(t_measure) |> 
  unnest(t_measure) |> 
  mutate(epoch = if_else(t_measure <= 0, "pre-screening", "treatment") |> as_factor()) |> 
  ggplot(aes(t_measure)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = epoch), alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_discrete("", labels = str_to_title, type = AZ_palette) +
  scale_x_continuous("Week", breaks = (seq(0, 126, by = 12))) +
  labs(y = "Count", title = "Number of visits every week") +
  facet_wrap(vars(trial), scales = "free_y") +
  theme(legend.position = "top", axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7))
```

# Confirmed Response Competing Risks Model

```{r}
#| label: load-conf-resp-res 

tar_load(c("prior_confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res", "confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res"))
```

```{r}
#| label: conf-resp-hazard-ratio
#| cache: true

hb <- seq(0, 2, by = 0.1)

conf_resp_hazard_ratios <- lst(prior = prior_confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res, post = confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res) |> 
  map_dfr(get_conf_resp_hazard_ratios, .id = "fit_type")  

conf_resp_hazard_ratios |> 
  group_by(trial, fit_type) |> 
  reframe(t = hb[-1], bindist = rvar_sample_hist(patient_crcr_hazard_ratio, hb)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(t)) +
  stat_lineribbon(aes(ydist = bindist, color = fit_type, fill = fit_type),
                  alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 1,
                  step = "vh",
                  .width = c(0.5, 0.8)) +
  scale_color_discrete(type = AZ_palette, aesthetics = c("color", "fill")) +
  facet_wrap(vars(trial)) +
  NULL
```

```{r}

covar_param <- lst(prior = prior_confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res, post = confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res) |> 
  map_dfr(get_conf_resp_covar_param, .id = "fit_type") 

covar_param |> 
  mutate(k = factor(k, levels = 1:2, labels = c("Response", "Non-response"))) |> 
  ggplot() +
  stat_halfeye(aes(xdist = crcr_covar_effect, y = factor(covar), color = fit_type, fill = fit_type), alpha = 0.25, .width = 0.8) +
  scale_y_discrete("Parameter") +
  scale_color_discrete(type = AZ_palette, aesthetics = c("color", "fill")) +
  facet_grid(vars(k), vars(trial))
```

```{r}

tumor_param <- lst(prior = prior_confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res, post = confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res) |> 
  map_dfr(get_conf_resp_tumor_param, .id = "fit_type") 

tumor_param |> 
  mutate(k = factor(k, levels = 1:2, labels = c("Response", "Non-response"))) |> 
  ggplot() +
  stat_halfeye(aes(xdist = crcr_tumor_stim_pop_coef, y = factor(m), color = fit_type, fill = fit_type), alpha = 0.25, .width = 0.8) +
  scale_y_discrete("Parameter") +
  scale_color_discrete(type = AZ_palette, aesthetics = c("color", "fill")) +
  facet_grid(vars(k), vars(trial))
```


```{r}

conf_resp_cif <- lst(prior = prior_confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res, post = confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res) |> 
  map_dfr(get_conf_resp_cif, .id = "fit_type") 

conf_resp_prob_confirmed <- conf_resp_cif |> 
  group_by(fit_type, trial, i, k) |> 
  filter(min_rank(t) == n()) |> 
  group_by(fit_type, trial, i) |> 
  mutate(cif = cif / rvar_sum(cif)) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  filter(k == 2)

conf_resp_cif |> 
  filter(trial == "Breast04", i == 86) |>
  ggplot(aes(t)) +
  stat_lineribbon(aes(ydist = cif, color = fit_type, fill = fit_type), alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 2, .width = c(0.5, 0.8)) +
  scale_color_discrete(type = AZ_palette, aesthetics = c("color", "fill")) +
  facet_wrap(vars(k))
```

```{r}
conf_resp_prob <- lst(prior = prior_confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res, post = confirmed_resp_comp_risk_res) |> 
  map_dfr(get_conf_resp_prob, .id = "fit_type") 
```
